blackboxstrategies-blackbox-strategies:a.title: Marketing Automation Specialist
blackboxstrategies-blackbox-strategies:a.description: MARKETING AUTOMATION SPECIALIST ROLE OVERVIEW BlackBox Strategies is seeking a senior, execution-first operator to own outbound and lifecycle messaging across both B2B and B2C audiences. This role is ideal for someone who: - Is an expert at hands-on execution - Can collaborate on strategy, then independently ship - Understands how B2B and B2C motions differ across email, CRM, and SMS - Works closely with a Social Media Manager to align messaging and timing You will partner with leadership on direction and priorities, then own execution end-to-end. ABOUT BLACKBOX STRATEGIES BlackBox Strategies is a revenue execution agency that helps businesses grow through disciplined GTM strategy, outbound execution, and lifecycle optimization. We design and operate revenue systems across email, CRM, and digital channels—bridging strategy and hands-on execution to drive measurable results for both B2B and B2C clients. LOCATION Remote | Open to global candidates (U.S. business hours required) KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Cold Email & Outbound Execution - Build and maintain outbound lists and enrichment workflows using Clay - Launch, manage, and optimize cold email campaigns in Instantly - Own inbox health, deliverability, warm-up, and reply categorization - Sync replies, outcomes, and lifecycle stages into HubSpot - Continuously test messaging by segment, persona, and intent Lifecycle & Marketing Email (B2B + B2C) - Build segmented audiences across lead, prospect, and customer stages - Execute nurture, re-engagement, abandoned inquiry, and expansion campaigns - Manage compliance, suppression logic, and list hygiene - Use HubSpot Marketing Hub and/or Mailchimp SMS Marketing (Nice to Have) - Support compliant, high-intent SMS use cases (follow-ups, reminders, re-engagement) - Experience with platforms such as Twilio or similar is a strong plus - Coordinate SMS timing with email and social campaigns Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate closely with the Social Media Manager to align themes, CTAs, and timing - Share outbound insights to inform social and content strategy - Partner with leadership on ICPs, testing priorities, and iteration REQUIREMENTS - Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in outbound, lifecycle marketing, or RevOps-adjacent roles - Direct experience executing (not just overseeing) email and CRM campaigns - Experience supporting both B2B and B2C audiences - Strong understanding of deliverability, segmentation, and channel tradeoffs - Clear written communicator with a bias toward execution - Comfortable operating with high-level direction in a fast-moving environment BENEFITS - Competitive compensation - Flexible, fully remote work environment - Opportunity to directly influence pipeline and revenue - Close collaboration with strategy, social, and GTM leadership - Exposure to modern outbound, CRM, and AI-enabled workflows

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:41.title: Tow Truck Operator
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:41.description: Position Summary: We are looking for a dependable and skilled Heavy Wrecker & Light-Duty Tow Operator to join our towing and recovery team. This role is responsible for safely operating heavy wreckers and rotators for large-scale recoveries, while also handling light-duty towing and roadside service for passenger vehicles. The ideal candidate is versatile, safety-conscious, and committed to providing professional customer service in both heavy and light-duty operations.
responsibilities: Safely operate  heavy-duty wreckers and recovery equipment  to tow and recover commercial trucks, buses, and heavy machinery.
Perform  light-duty towing and roadside assistance  for passenger vehicles, including jump starts, lockouts, tire changes, and fuel deliveries.
Assess accident and breakdown scenes, determine recovery needs, and execute plans in a safe, efficient manner.
Properly rig, secure, and transport vehicles of all sizes using approved equipment and methods.
Communicate with dispatch, customers, and emergency responders to coordinate safe and timely service.
Complete accurate service tickets, condition reports, and time logs for all calls.
Conduct daily inspections of trucks and towing equipment; report any maintenance issues.
Adhere to DOT, OSHA, and company safety standards in all towing and recovery operations.
Represent the company with professionalism and courtesy at every call.
qualifications: Experience operating heavy wreckers or recovery equipment (preferred).
Prior light-duty towing or roadside assistance experience a plus.
Strong knowledge of recovery, rigging, and safety techniques for both light and heavy vehicles.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and on-call rotations.
Strong communication skills and customer service mindset.

farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:a242baa0-97.title: Senior Data Scientist
farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:a242baa0-97.description: Luxclusif is a technology-driven global B2B platform founded in 2013 and part of Farfetch since 2021. Dedicated to redefining the luxury paradigm by offering premium pre-owned fashion to a global audience, Luxclusif has pioneered the global luxury resale market, with advanced data-driven solutions to facilitate the buying and selling of high-end pre-owned items. With operations spread across the globe and strategic warehouses in key locations, ensure a seamless supply of luxury goods, ensuring item curation, quality control, operations, logistics to technology integrations and sales, delivering an unmatched resale experience for brands, retailers, and end-customers. THE TEAM Our R&D team is responsible for designing, developing, and evolving the internal products that power our business. As a B2B company specialising in second-hand luxury items, we rely on technology to optimise every stage of our operations, from buying and inbound logistics to selling and post-sales support. We are a global team with members across Portugal, Brazil, and the Philippines. PORTO Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. THE ROLE As a Data Scientist you will be part of a multidisciplinary team within the Data cluster, responsible for the development of strategic data products to enable company competitiveness and analytical insights collaborating closer with the R&D Products line. We're looking for a team player that is passionate about tech products and is looking for eager opportunities to grow.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1d527edc-6f3d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Content Writer (Freelance) based in Germany. This is a flexible freelance opportunity for a talented writer who can create engaging, informative, and audience-focused content across digital channels. You will contribute to content that strengthens brand visibility, communicates ideas clearly, and encourages meaningful audience engagement. The role offers variety across blog posts, articles, website copy, social media content, and other formats. You will need to adapt your tone, structure, and storytelling approach to suit different audiences and platforms. The ideal candidate combines excellent writing skills with creativity, research ability, and strong attention to detail. This is a great fit for an independent writer who enjoys working across diverse content needs in a flexible environment. Create compelling, engaging, and informative content for a variety of digital channels and audiences. Strong ability to adapt writing style and tone according to the subject matter, audience, and communication channel. Excellent research skills and the ability to turn complex or broad topics into clear, accessible, and engaging content. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and quality. A portfolio demonstrating relevant writing experience and versatility across content formats is preferred. jobgether-jobgether:lever:1daf9361-47ad-.title: Operations Supervisor
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1daf9361-47ad-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Operations Supervisor based in Australia. This is a remote operations leadership role focused on scaling and maintaining a high-performing distributed workforce. You will work closely with the Operations Manager to translate broader objectives into effective day-to-day execution. Your focus will include workforce planning, attendance, quality assurance, coaching, onboarding, and operational administration. You will help grow the operation toward a target of 100 active agents while maintaining consistent performance and reliability. The role suits a hands-on operational leader who is comfortable managing people, monitoring performance, and addressing issues quickly. Strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail will be essential to keeping the operation running smoothly as it expands. Work closely with the Operations Manager to execute daily operational priorities and ensure activities remain aligned with broader business objectives. Manage and maintain an accurate roster of active agents, applying established policies to identify inactive agents and coordinate timely replacements. Monitor agent attendance and schedules to ensure team members consistently complete their required 8-hour daily shifts. Conduct daily test calls and quality checks to verify that agents meet established quality standards and operational expectations. Provide timely, constructive coaching and follow-up when quality issues, complaints, or performance concerns arise. Support workforce growth and capacity planning with the objective of building and maintaining a team of up to 100 active agents. Manage onboarding and compliance activities by reviewing required documentation, communicating status updates, and maintaining organized records. Calculate, prepare, and submit the operation’s monthly minutes-based invoice accurately and on time. Track operational performance, identify gaps, and take appropriate corrective action to maintain productivity, quality, and workforce stability. Requirements Demonstrated experience in operations, workforce management, team supervision, customer support, or a related operational environment. Strong ability to manage distributed or remote teams while maintaining accountability for attendance, productivity, and quality. Experience monitoring performance against defined standards and providing constructive coaching when issues arise. Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accurate rosters, schedules, documentation, and operational records. Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, operational tracking systems, and basic financial or invoicing information. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies, follow established procedures, and maintain accurate records. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with agents, managers, and clients. Proactive and hands-on approach to problem-solving, with the ability to respond quickly to operational issues. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with operational leadership. Results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on team growth, quality, attendance, and consistent execution. Benefits Base salary: $200 per month. Performance-based bonus: 1% of the operation’s total gross monthly invoice. Bonus eligibility: The performance bonus becomes available once more than 20 active agents are maintained while completing their required 8-hour shifts. Growth-based earning potential: Compensation increases as the size and gross invoice value of the operation grows. Target earning example: At 100 active agents, the minimum gross monthly invoice is approximately $84,400, generating a minimum $844 performance bonus. Expected minimum monthly compensation at 100 active agents: $1,044, consisting of the $200 base salar

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d57e249e-cfac-.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Checkout & Payments
jobgether-jobgether:lever:d57e249e-cfac-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer - Checkout & Payments based in the United States. This is a senior full stack engineering role focused on building a world-class consumer checkout and payments experience. You’ll own substantial, user-facing initiatives from concept through launch, working in a small team of highly experienced engineers with significant autonomy. The role combines modern frontend engineering with backend APIs, data models, and payment infrastructure. You’ll partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Design to shape experiences that improve conversion and make complex healthcare spending simple for consumers. Performance, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making will be central to your work. You’ll also help establish frontend standards and technical practices as the platform scales. Own large, user-facing product initiatives from initial concept and technical design through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration. Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Design to define the direction of the consumer web experience and translate business objectives into high-quality technical solutions. Build and optimize modern frontend experiences using technologies such as Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind. Establish and evolve frontend engineering standards, patterns, and development practices across the team. Improve website performance by analyzing rendering behavior, page-load characteristics, Core Web Vitals, and other relevant performance metrics. Develop scalable frontend architecture using component libraries, monorepos, headless CMS platforms, and other modern web development approaches. Design, build, and expand backend APIs and data models that support important product and checkout initiatives. Work across the full technology stack, investigating issues and opportunities from the user interface through backend services and data layers. Experiment with product experiences and use quantitative data to evaluate results, improve conversion, and guide product decisions. Contribute to checkout and payment-related infrastructure, with an opportunity to shape reliable and intuitive payment experiences. Partner with other senior engineers to maintain high technical standards while operating with significant autonomy and ownership. Help evolve the engineering architecture and technical foundation as the product and consumer base continue to grow. Requirements Senior-level software engineering experience on high-performing engineering teams, with strong expertise in modern frontend development. Advanced experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, or comparable technologies. Strong understanding of frontend rendering behavior, particularly within frameworks such as Next.js, and demonstrated ability to optimize page-load performance. Practical experience using Core Web Vitals and related performance metrics to identify and resolve frontend performance issues. Experience building and maintaining large-scale frontend applications using concepts such as component libraries, monorepos, and headless CMS platforms. Strong backend development experience with Python, Django, or comparable technologies. Experience designing, consuming, and extending backend APIs and data models. Ability and willingness to work across the entire stack, from polished user interfaces through backend services and data infrastructure. Strong product mindset and interest in experimentation, conversion optimization, and data-driven decision-making. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Marketing, Design, and Engineering stakeholders. Comfortable operating autonomously, taking ownership of ambiguous problems, and driving initiatives from inception to completion. Experience with payment systems or payment infrastructure is a strong

matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:e809d32c-e47.title: Staff Recruiter
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:e809d32c-e47.description: Know where you belong! Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire. When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week. About the Role As a Staff Recruiter, you'll lead hiring across our Product, Design, Engineering and Analytics organizations, partnering closely with senior leaders as a trusted talent advisor. You'll help shape hiring decisions by providing market insights, talent intelligence, and data-driven recommendations that enable thoughtful, long-term growth. This is a highly visible, high-impact role for a recruiter who thinks beyond individual requisitions. You'll influence talent strategy, anticipate hiring needs before they emerge, and bring a strong point of view on how to attract, assess, and hire exceptional talent. Success in this role requires a blend of strategic thinking, business acumen, and the ability to build credibility with stakeholders at every level of the organization. This role is based out of our Dallas office.
responsibilities: Talent Strategy & Executive Partnership

Partner with senior DEPA leaders to develop proactive hiring strategies aligned with long-term workforce plans. Translate market intelligence and hiring data into actionable recommendations, anticipate talent needs before they emerge, and challenge assumptions with data-backed perspectives.
Recruiting Excellence & Process Leadership

Lead end-to-end hiring for critical DEPA roles while continuously improving interview frameworks, assessment methodologies, and hiring processes. Drive calibration, elevate hiring rigor through structured interviewing, and leverage AI-enabled tools and analytics to improve efficiency and decision-making.
Market Intelligence & Talent Mapping

Maintain deep expertise across technical talent markets — tracking competitive landscapes, compensation trends, and emerging skill sets. Conduct talent mapping, execute sophisticated multi-channel sourcing strategies, and regularly brief leaders on market conditions to inform workforce planning.
Inclusive Hiring & Talent Attraction

Embed equitable, structured hiring practices throughout the recruiting lifecycle. Partner with talent communities and strategic sourcing channels to expand access to underrepresented talent and champion a consistent, values-driven candidate experience.
Talent Brand & Candidate Experience

Serve as a compelling ambassador for Match Group — articulating our mission, culture, and value proposition authentically. Build high-touch candidate relationships and partner cross-functionally to strengthen employer branding initiatives.
Offer Strategy & Stakeholder Management

Guide leaders through complex hiring decisions balancing candidate experience, market realities, and internal equity. Develop competitive offer strategies and build strong partnerships across TA, People, Compensation, and business leadership to drive alignment and achieve hiring goals.

partyhat-partyhat:ashbyhq:c60fb402-f844-.title: Venture Architect
partyhat-partyhat:ashbyhq:c60fb402-f844-.description: THE MISSION We aren't looking for a traditional corporate strategist or a passive consultant. We need a "Company Builder" who can take raw ideas and transform them into high-growth, market-ready ecosystems with surgical precision. Your job is to lead venture ideation, engineer bulletproof business models, and execute validation strategies that lay the foundation for the next generation of our digital footprint. This is a remote, high-availability role for a strategic operator who views business building as an elite craft and is comfortable operating at the absolute forefront of the Web3 economy. We value execution over theory. Whether you are a multi-time founder or an elite product strategist with a track record of launching successful ecosystems, we care about your ability to move from 0 to 1. If you have the analytical rigor to validate markets under pressure and the communication skills to collaborate with top-tier founders, we will give you the capital and infrastructure to turn ambition into economic reality. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Venture Ideation: Proactively scout market inefficiencies, consumer trends, and technological shifts to conceptualize high-velocity digital ventures. - Business Model Design: Architect the economic engine, incentive structures, and financial models for new ventures, ensuring long-term sustainability and market dominance. - Market Validation: Deploy rigorous quantitative and qualitative validation frameworks to stress-test concepts against real-world demand before deploying significant capital. - Go-to-Market Strategy: Design and orchestrate high-impact launch strategies, identifying distribution channels and growth loops that maximize early adoption and momentum. - Founder Collaboration: Partner closely with incoming founders and executive talent, serving as the strategic backbone during the critical early phases of formation. - Venture Incubation: Oversee the end-to-end incubation pipeline, guiding ventures from initial blueprint through proof-of-concept to fully independent execution. THE REQUIREMENTS - The "Builder": Proven experience launching digital products, platforms, or companies from the ground up. You know the friction points of the 0-to-1 journey and how to bypass them. - Analytical Rigor: You don't make business decisions based on "gut feeling." You are comfortable looking at raw market data, user behavior, and financial projections to make cold, calculated decisions. - Hyper-Availability: This isn't a 9-to-5. Building companies requires deep focus and real-time pivoting. You must be available 7 days a week to capitalize on market windows and keep incubation timelines moving. - Web3 Literacy: You possess a deep understanding of the Web3 landscape. You understand decentralized networks, digital asset mechanics, and the unique psychology of internet-native communities. - Operational Excellence: Self-motivated and highly organized; you can balance multiple venture blueprints and founder workstreams simultaneously without losing track of the fine details. OPERATIONAL DETAILS - Location: Fully Remote. - Schedule: On-call 7 days a week (Requires high flexibility to handle rapid incubation cycles and global founder coordination). - Payment: All compensation is processed in digital assets (USDC/USDT). WHY JOIN US? We offer more than just a strategic role; we offer a masterclass in the future of institutional company building. - Extreme Autonomy: We value output over red tape. You will have the freedom to design, validate, and launch ventures within a high-speed, high-trust environment. - Uncapped Leverage: Bring your ideas to a powerhouse that has the distribution, technical talent, and capital to scale them instantly. - A Culture of Momentum: Join a team that moves at the speed of light. You will be constantly building, testing, and shipping new economic engines. - High-Growth Upside: We value "potential over pedigree." For a Venture Architect who consistently spins up winning ecosystems

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:9daf21ca-ba81-49bd.title: Marketing Designer
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:9daf21ca-ba81-49bd.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Marketing Designer, який не просто малює — а вирішує бізнес-виклики через дослідження, ідеї та результативний дизайн. Пропонуємо ремоут-формат. Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі: — Проектування ефективних маркетингових воронок; — Створення user-flow на цільових сторінках; — Генерувати гіпотези та валідувати їх через величезну кількість A/B тестів; — Аналіз воронок прямих та непрямих конкурентів; — Аналіз поведінки користувачів через внутришні інструменти аналітики; — Тісна взаємодія з сильною командою дизайнерів, розробників та аналітиків. Що для нас важливо: — Від 1 року досвіду у сфері веб-дизайну; — Володіння інструментом Figma на високому рівні; — Знання основ композиції, типографіки та кольористики; — Бізнес-орієнтованість — дизайн не заради краси, а в першу чергу задля зростання конверсії; — Вміння структуровано подати інформацію (результати проведеного дослідження; презентація концепту; ідеї для брейншторму); — Вміння аргументувати свої рішення; — Вміння сприймати зворотній конструктивинй фібдек; — Бажання розвиватися та зростати по сенйоріті. Що ти отримаєш разом з нами: — Простір для генерацї та реалізації власних гіпотез в CRO форматі; — Вплив на метрики бізнесу та тестування гіпотез на реальних користувачах; — Повний тул-кіт, включно з повним пакетом платних підписок різноманітних дизайн та АІ інструментів (Figma, Claude, ChatGPT, Leonardo та ін.). У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. - Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. - Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави. - Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат — з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше. - Турбота про щоденний комфорт. Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів. Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві. Запрошуємо будувати the next big eve

southparkcommons-pulley:ashbyhq:3fd163dd.description: About Pulley Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects. Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays. We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams. Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore. 🧑‍💻 THE ROLE As a Senior Recruiter, you'll play a key role in building Pulley's team and business. You'll manage end-to-end recruiting with a focus on building exceptional pipelines for specialized roles outside the usual tech recruiting playbook. As an early recruiting hire, you'll have the opportunity to shape our talent acquisition strategy and processes. 📋 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Run full recruiting cycles - source, screen, close - Build deep pipelines via sourcing, especially for specialized roles - Partner with hiring managers and leadership on recruiting strategies - Create exceptional candidate experiences - Collaborate to improve our recruiting operations 👋 WHO YOU ARE - Track record scaling teams at fast-growing companies - Highly organized, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities - Data-driven approach to recruiting - Knack for creative problem-solving and a bias for action - Passionate about Pulley's mission - Eager to work on-site in Manhattan 3x / week
